crossRefs.note: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven…
You shall not go out from the door of the Tent of Meeting for seven days, until the days of your consecration are…

translations.web: “Seven days you shall prepare every day a goat for a sin offering. They shall also prepare a young bull, and a ram out of the flock, without defect.
translations.bsb: For seven days you are to provide a male goat daily for a sin offering; you are also to provide a young bull and a ram from the flock, both unblemished.
translations.kjv: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
translations.asv: Seven days shalt thou prepare every day a goat for a sin-offering: they shall also prepare a young bullock, and a ram out of the flock, without blemish.
